2026 Postseason

Twelve teams make it — six per league. The three division winners with the best records are seeds 1–3, and the three best remaining records are the Wild Cards, seeds 4–6. Seeds 1 and 2 get a bye straight to the Division Series.

Wild Card Series are best-of-three, all at the higher seed's park. Division Series are best-of-five; the League Championship Series and World Series are best-of-seven. Tap any matchup for its game-by-game results.
